description: Keyboard-based random note generator holding 25 settings, with a probability and a root octave for each of the twelve notes, and a separate spread of random octave offsets

params.text: Selects which of the 25 stored settings is active: the probabilities, octave anchors and octave ranges held in the keys. The knob settings are global and are not stored with them
Sets how many steps of the lock buffer are repeated, 1 to 16
Sets the chance that the next note is taken from the lock buffer rather than generated afresh; at 0% every note is new, at 100% every note is a repeat, and around 90% a pattern morphs slowly
Turns LOCK fully the opposite way for one step: it injects a repeat when LOCK is below 50%, and a fresh random note when LOCK is above 50%
Shifts the octave ranges up or down; the keys draw the shifted shape in red over the original in green
Narrows the spread of the octave ranges as it is turned up; the keys draw the narrowed shape in red over the original in green
Puts the keyboard into note probability editing, where each key holds how often that note is generated
Puts the keyboard into octave anchor editing, where each key holds the octave its note is generated in; a key whose probability is zero cannot be set
Puts the keyboard into octave range editing, where the white keys hold the probability of each octave offset from -3 to +3
Sets the probability that a step plays at all, as a percentage; at 0% no notes come out unless LOCK is repeating them. Its light is red when some notes will be skipped and green when none will be
Copies the probabilities, octave anchors and octave ranges of the selected setting to the clipboard, so they can be pasted into another index or another Prob-Key
Pastes copied probabilities, octave anchors and octave ranges into the selected setting
Transposes the note probabilities of the selected setting up one semitone, moving the octave anchors to match; it does nothing while octave range editing is selected
Transposes the note probabilities of the selected setting down one semitone, moving the octave anchors to match; it does nothing while octave range editing is selected

inputs.text: Added to the INDEX knob to pick the setting, a semitone per setting: 0V is the first and 2V the twenty-fifth, matching the notes C4 to C6
Added to the LENGTH knob; 10V adds the full 16 steps
Added to the LOCK knob; 10V takes it to full lock
Added to the OFFSET knob, 10V shifting the octave ranges by three octaves; a polyphonic cable sets the offset of each voice separately
Added to the SQUASH knob, a tenth of its range per volt; a polyphonic cable sets the squash of each voice separately
A gate or a trigger here generates a note, so this input is what sets the tempo; the module has no clock of its own. A polyphonic gate generates a separate note on each channel
While this is high, each note that would be generated repeats the one before it, which can be used for ratcheting
Added to the DENSITY knob, a tenth of its range per volt; a polyphonic cable sets the density of each voice separately

outputs.text: A copy of the gate input while a note plays, and 0V on a step that was skipped

notes: a key is set by how far down it the click lands, the top of the key being the maximum; holding shift while clicking sets every note to that value, or sets the octave ranges symmetrically
there is no clock input and no reset input: every note is generated by a gate arriving at the GATE input, so that input is what sets the tempo
menu: Index mode 12 — maps the index knob and its CV input onto settings 1 to 12, so the note class picks the setting and every C selects the first; negative voltages are mapped too
Squash overlap — a slider setting how much the octave ranges overlap as SQUASH is turned up: at 100% every range but the centre one narrows together, at 0% they narrow one after another
Show generated note — lights the top light of the key being played, white for a new note and red for a locked one, held for 3 seconds after each gate
Manual step lock — locks individual steps of the lock buffer by hand, and holds Clear all locks, Set locks of active steps, Reset playhead and Per index manual locks
Portable sequence — holds Copy sequence and Paste sequence, which move the lock buffer between this module and other sequencers that support the format
Paste weights from Adaptive Quantizer — sets the note probabilities of the selected setting from the twelve weights that Adaptive Quantizer's Copy weights for ProbKey put on the clipboard
